title: Chicken satay skewers with light peanut sauce
steps: Cut the chicken into strips and marinate with soy sauce, turmeric and garlic for 15 minutes, then thread onto skewers.
Cook in a griddle pan in the oil for 3–4 minutes per side.
Stir the peanut butter with lime juice, sambal and 2–3 tbsp hot water and serve with the skewers and cucumber.
